notes.title: NEW UPDATE IN THE WORKS!!!!!
notes.content: A new update is still in the works, and now the computer in the store is now available to buy, what this means is that when you purchase it, there will be a computer in your home where you can purchase anything you need there, some will be in bulk, but everything will be more money due to shipping. When you buy something you will have to wait a bit then a package will show up at your door.

notes.title: Christmas Update Released
notes.content: The Christmas update is finally here. The update contains snow and snowmen on the ground. A Christmas hat that when you press F on it you will wear it and it will play a Christmas song. A new sale running from December 22nd - January 5th. I hope you guys have a great christmas.

notes.title: Update V0.4 LIVE
notes.content: The new update took longer than expected but it is now live. This update removes the halloween update, and also I added a user feedback button on the main menu so if you guys have any feedback please feel free to press that button and fill out that form. Thanks.

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE RELEASED
notes.content: The Halloween update is finally live and ready to play. I fixed a bunch of bugs and added a cutscene your first time playing. This update will go till November 5th, so be sure to play during the update to see and feel the creepy vibes and environment.

tags.bug: I fixed a bunch of bugs and added a cutscene your first time playing.

notes.title: UPDATE V0.3 LIVE
notes.content: Update v0.3 is now live. I changed how sleeping works before the tiredness progress bar would go up based on when you went to sleep didn't matter when. Now if you go to bed during day you get less sleep and night it fills up all the way and it increases time by a bit so days feel faster. Also a very requested feature and that's graphics settings. It still needs more features but its a start. I also fixed some minor bugs that weren't game breaking.

notes.title: UPDATE V0.2 LIVE
notes.content: The first update is now live since the release. The update contains a new stats menu look and also a new stat bar. The new bar is hunger so now when eating it will give you health and go towards the hunger bar. If your hunger bar is empty your movement speed lowers.
